title.narrative: Supporting Uganda’s Response to HIV/AIDS and Tuberculosis Reduction Strategy - Uganda (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Uganda, TB/HIV, The AIDS Support Organisation (Uganda) Limited (TASO)This program has the following goals: Increase productivity, inclusiveness and well-being of the population by ending HIV and AIDS as an epidemic by 2030.. The objectives of this program are: To reduce new HIV infections by 65% among adults and youth, and to reduce new paediatric HIV infections to less than 5% by 2025.. To reduce AIDS-related morbidity and mortality by 2025.. To strengthen social and economic protection to reduce vulnerability to HIV and AIDS and to mitigate their impact on people living with HIV, orphans and other vulnerable children (OVC), KPs and other vulnerable groups.. To strengthen the multi-sectoral HIV and AIDS service delivery and coordination system that ensures sustainable access to efficient and quality services for all focus populations.. To strengthen the national HIV and AIDS strategic information management system for improved effectiveness and efficiency.
